supersedes.reason: Narrow repair of demonstrated rule-level blockers I-3 through I-6 from non-qualifying technical analysis; no runtime-boundary implementation is introduced.

non_qualifying_technical_analysis.independence_failure: Reviewer participated in authoring/publishing both exact review targets.

immutable_supporting_capture.use_limit: May support feasibility/provenance review only; observed names, multiplicities, closure, or launch contents MUST NOT define expected manifest membership.

complete_runtime_universe_rule.construction_time: Before sealed-worker start and before any claim, allocation request, seed read, admission, or game initialization.
prospective_inputs: Exact reviewed source commit/tree and every build input: Gradle wrapper script/JAR/properties, Gradle distribution, settings/included builds, buildSrc/convention plugins, version catalogs, dependency locks and verification metadata, repositories, compiler/Kotlin/JDK toolchains, and all source/resource inputs.

Accepted immutable 1,339-file dependency-store manifest/artifact plus accepted outer/archive/manifest digests; no network resolution, fallback repository, mutable cache substitution, dynamic/changing dependency, or unverified dependency is permitted.

Ordered effective classpath and module path for every launcher, Gradle daemon/launcher where present, and test-worker process, including Gradle bootstrap/test-worker implementation, test framework, AI main/test outputs, rules-engine main/test fixtures, SDK, logging, and every transitive artifact.

Complete inventory of every directory output and every archive member, including classes, generated serializers, top-level/nested/anonymous/synthetic classes, service descriptors and all other resources; bind complete archive bytes, member inventory, multi-release-JAR selection for the pinned JDK, and exact independently reviewed precedence for any intentional duplicate resource.

Exact pinned JDK distribution/image digest, release/modules, executables and native libraries; exact linux/amd64 container image digest, architecture, dynamic loader and native-library dependency closure.

Exact Python interpreter binary, standard library and import closure used by admission/receiving code; exact shell/just/executable launcher chain; exact command arguments, working directory and allowed environment.
Exact loader topology/delegations, effective code sources and immutable mount mapping for launcher/Gradle/worker processes.

Every generated or transient pre-launch class/resource only when its generation recipe, generator bytes, complete immutable inputs and output bytes are prospectively bound and deterministically reproducible before manifest publication.
forbidden_undeclared_influence: undeclared environment variables or filesystem roots
complete_runtime_universe_rule.closure_rule: The independently reviewed resolved graphs plus actual ordered process paths and import/native/loader/resource graphs must establish exact complete closure. No reachable-only whitelist, observed-worker whitelist, source-filename inventory, successful-test inference, or launch-derived learning is permitted.
canonical_serialization: Explicit ordinals for ordered process/classpath/module-path/loader entries.
Origin category, loader identity, artifact/entry type, byte length and lowercase SHA-256 for every ordinary manifest member.

Duplicate keys, ambiguous names, traversal, duplicate ZIP members, symlinks, missing/unexpected roots, duplicate binary names without an independently reviewed resolution, and unknown fields are fatal.
complete_runtime_universe_rule.manifest_publication_rule: A canonical manifest may be emitted only after complete closure is established and every generated/transient pre-launch byte is reproducible from the declared immutable inputs. Non-reproducible drift is a qualification failure and MUST NOT be normalized, reblessed, learned from receiving evidence, or omitted.
complete_runtime_universe_rule.closure_failure_rule: If any required graph edge, loader/delegation, native dependency, Python import, launcher component, environment influence, archive/directory member, generated/transient byte, or provenance relationship cannot be completely enumerated and verified, the builder emits a failure record only. It MUST NOT emit or adopt a canonical manifest, the worker MUST NOT produce a prepared-worker attestation, Python MUST NOT admit, and no claim/allocation/seed read/game initialization may occur.

generated_hidden_class_rule.ordinary_generated_classes: Any non-VM generated class or resource must either be eliminated or be generated before launch reproducibly from manifest-bound immutable inputs and included by exact bytes in the ordinary manifest. Application/test/framework-defined runtime bytecode generation, runtime compilation, custom/application-defined class loaders, downloaded classes, append-to-classpath mechanisms, Java/native agents, instrumentation, retransformation and hot replacement are prohibited.

permitted_generators.definition_mechanism: MethodHandles.Lookup hidden-class definition reported by the pinned JVM as __JVM_LookupDefineClass__

permitted_generators.permitted_output_family: JDK lambda proxy hidden classes generated solely for manifest-bound call sites
permitted_generators.definition_mechanism: MethodHandles.Lookup hidden-class definition reported by the pinned JVM as __JVM_LookupDefineClass__

only_permitted_exact_name_exception.generator_identity_rule: The exact module image plus exact .class bytes for every permitted generator and the Lookup definition implementation must be bound by SHA-256 from the pinned JDK before qualification. A package/module wildcard, a different JDK build, a different generator class, or any third-party/application generator is not permitted.
only_permitted_exact_name_exception.generator_inputs: Generator inputs are limited to the exact pinned JDK module image, manifest-bound ordinary classes/resources/call sites, and the sealed process arguments/environment. Every non-JDK parent/capturing/interface/target definition participating in generation must already be ordinary-manifest-bound. No network, mutable external file, unmanifested class/resource, custom loader, agent or runtime compiler may contribute.
only_permitted_exact_name_exception.loading_mechanism: Only JVM lookup-defined hidden-class loading through the pinned java.base Lookup implementation is permitted. The resulting definition must be hidden and lookup-defined by the pinned JVM. Any generated non-hidden class, Proxy/ProxyGenerator output, Unsafe/defineClass path, custom/application loader, or different definition mechanism is outside this exception and fails unless separately prospectively adopted.
only_permitted_exact_name_exception.member_identity_rule: Exact hidden-member suffixes/addresses and multiplicity are not ordinary manifest members. The permitted provenance category is determined by the fixed generator allowlist, exact generator bytes, exact input-origin rule, fixed lookup-definition mechanism and permitted output family. Receiving-launch observations MUST NOT add a generator, output family or input source.
only_permitted_exact_name_exception.non_redefinition_constraints: Permitted hidden definitions may not redefine, replace, shadow or mutate any ordinary manifest class/resource. Java/native agents, instrumentation, retransformation, hotswap/redefinition, append-to-classpath and custom runtime loaders remain disabled for the full process lifetime.
only_permitted_exact_name_exception.unknown_family_rule: Any generated/hidden class outside these exact generator/mechanism categories is a hard failure. It requires a separate prospective rule amendment with its own exact generator, inputs, loading mechanism and non-redefinition constraints, independently adopted before implementation qualification.

admission_and_lifetime_rule: Before any claim creation, require the independently accepted complete manifest, this adopted boundary-rule digest, immutable build/qualification evidence, and exact independent reviewer binding.

Before Python admit or any allocation request/game initialization, the prepared worker must verify actual ordered process paths, loader topology, immutable archive/directory bytes, complete inventories, JDK/container/native/Python/launcher identities, and the generated-hidden rule against the adopted authority.

Prepared-worker attestation must bind source/tree, manifest and review digests, runtime receipt, execution owner, unique worker process instance and a fresh single-use launch identity through a reviewed authenticated process channel or equivalent sealed-launch mechanism. Caller-supplied booleans and replayable JSON are insufficient.

Executable sources and mounts stay sealed for the entire process lifetime; extension paths remain disabled; later loads are checked against the same rule. Unknown source, loader, generator, definition mechanism, artifact mismatch or integrity failure stops before the next admission; after initialization it quarantines the sample under the frozen no-retry rule.
No fallback, repair-in-place, replacement worker, continuation, or replacement sample is permitted.
implementation_scope_after_independent_a: Canonical offline complete-manifest builder and schema implementing the entire complete_runtime_universe_rule.
Constrained loader/worker enforcing ordinary manifest membership and the generated_hidden_class_rule.
Prepared-worker freshness/replay-resistant attestation and immutable lifetime enforcement.
Python admission receiver that independently verifies the attestation and refuses replay/stale/wrong-worker/source/review/runtime bindings.

Deterministic non-corpus fixtures covering missing/extra dependency/root/class/resource, changed class/resource/JAR/JDK/launcher/Python bytes, classpath/module-path order, duplicate/shadow/multi-release handling, loader/agent/option/environment injection, non-reproducible generated/transient bytes, unknown hidden family/generator, later mutation/load, stale/replayed/wrong-worker attestation, source/review mismatch, and refusal before admit/initialization.
